description: This file contains implementations related to communication primitives used in Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) training within torch.distributed, including AllGather, ReduceScatter, and related utilities for tensor allocation, communication, and synchronization in distributed training scenarios.

classes.name: AllGatherResult
classes.description: A NamedTuple that encapsulates the results of an all-gather operation, including output tensor, synchronization event, work handle, and metadata about input data types and sizes.

classes.name: DefaultAllocMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing a default tensor allocation method.

classes.name: ProcessGroupAllocMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing tensor allocation methods that use a specific process group.

methods.name: torch.Tensor allocate( self, size: Sequence[int | torch.SymInt], *, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device, )
methods.description: Allocates an uninitialized tensor of given size, dtype, and device. Provided by allocators in magin classes.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor] all_gather_copy_in_meta( all_gather_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], all_gather_output: torch.Tensor, inp_split_sizes: list[int], all_gather_input_numel: int, rank: int, )
methods.description: Meta implementation of the all_gather_copy_in operation, provides a placeholder for shape inference.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,torch.Tensor] all_gather_copy_in_cuda( all_gather_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], all_gather_output: torch.Tensor, inp_split_sizes: list[int], all_gather_input_numel: int, rank: int, )
methods.description: CUDA implementation of the all_gather_copy_in operation, performs the copy and prepares input for all gather.

methods.name: None split_with_sizes_copy( all_gather_output: torch.Tensor, all_gather_input_split_sizes: list[int], dim: int = 0, *, out: list[torch.Tensor], )
methods.description: Performs a split operation with specified sizes, used in partitioning the all-gather output.

methods.name: None chunk_cat( tensors: list[torch.Tensor], dim: int, num_chunks: int, out: torch.Tensor, )
methods.description: Concatenates tensors in chunks along a specified dimension.

methods.name: AllGatherResult|None foreach_all_gather( fsdp_params: list[FSDPParam], group: dist.ProcessGroup, async_op: bool, all_gather_copy_in_stream: torch.Stream, all_gather_stream: torch.Stream, device: torch.device, all_gather_comm: AllGather, )
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation asynchronously and gathers result metadata, managing streams and events.

methods.name: list[list[torch.Tensor]] _get_param_all_gather_inputs( fsdp_params: list[FSDPParam], )
methods.description: Gathers all-gather input tensors from FSDP parameters, optimized for autoregressive compilation.

methods.name: None foreach_all_gather_copy_out( all_gather_result: AllGatherResult, fsdp_params: list[FSDPParam], group: dist.ProcessGroup, )
methods.description: Distributes the all-gather results back into the individual parameter tensors' storage.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,torch.Event,torch.Event,torch.Tensor|None,torch.Event|None,torch.Tensor|None,] foreach_reduce( fsdp_params: list[FSDPParam], unsharded_grads: list[torch.Tensor], reduce_scatter_group: dist.ProcessGroup, reduce_scatter_stream: torch.Stream, reduce_scatter_comm: ReduceScatter, orig_dtype: torch.dtype | None, reduce_dtype: torch.dtype | None, device: torch.device, gradient_divide_factor: float | None, all_reduce_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None, all_reduce_stream: torch.Stream, all_reduce_grads: bool, partial_reduce_output: torch.Tensor | None, all_reduce_hook: Callable[[torch.Tensor], None] | None, force_sum_reduction_for_comms: bool = False, )
methods.description: Performs the reduce-scatter operation across parameters' gradients, including optional gradient averaging and hooks.

methods.name: None foreach_reduce_scatter_copy_in( unsharded_grads: list[torch.Tensor], reduce_scatter_input: torch.Tensor, world_size: int, )
methods.description: Copies gradients into a contiguous buffer for reduce-scatter operation across multiple parameters.

methods.name: tuple[list[list[torch.dtype]],list[list[int]],torch.dtype] _get_all_gather_input_metadatas( param_all_gather_inputs: list[list[torch.Tensor]], )
methods.description: Computes metadata such as data types and sizes for inputs to all-gather, handling type consistency.

methods.name: tuple[float|None,float|None,dist.ReduceOp|dist.ReduceOp.RedOpType,dist.ReduceOp|dist.ReduceOp.RedOpType,] _get_gradient_divide_factors( reduce_scatter_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None, all_reduce_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None, reduce_dtype: torch.dtype, device_type: str = "", factor: float | None = None, force_sum_reduction_for_comms: bool = False, )
methods.description: Determines pre- and post-scaling factors for gradient reduction, considering overflow risk and compression schemes.
